column7: 2026-11-04: pysemver sort: versions arg uses nargs='+' (not '*') so empty input errors instead of printing a blank line that Jenkins' 'while read v' would read as a version; invalid version prints nothing on stdout (rc 2) to avoid partial lists; cmd_sort deliberately not re-exported in semver/__init__.py because that import block comes from the deprecated module (tests import from semver.cli).

2026-11-04: pysemver sort: with no args reads stdin (one per line, blanks ignored); versions is nargs='*' now, but empty args+empty stdin still errors (rc 2, ValueError) to keep the earlier no-blank-line-for-Jenkins guarantee

2026-11-04: Release workflow is moving from Jenkins to GitHub Actions, which parses pysemver output with fromJSON(). From now on every NEW pysemver subcommand prints its result as JSON on stdout. Exception: 'sort' stays plain text, one per line, because the old Jenkins job still calls it until migration finishes.
2026-11-04: pysemver latest: prints JSON string (json.dumps) per the JSON rule for new subcommands; shares _read_versions with sort; errors (rc 2, empty stdout) when no input or only prereleases
